zh: 冷启动攻击：利用断电后 DRAM 残留数据恢复密钥。
DRAM：常温下断电后短时间内仍保留内容的动态随机存取存储器。
剩余记忆：断电后内存数据逐渐衰减但仍可读取的现象。
全盘加密：对存储设备整体加密，挂载期间密钥通常留在内存中。
内存加密：对内存内容加密；只有在复位或断电时销毁密钥，才可能阻止冷启动恢复。
侧信道：利用物理实现的泄漏而非数学弱点。
en: Cold boot attack: recovering keys from DRAM data that survives power loss.
DRAM: dynamic random-access memory that retains contents briefly at room temperature after power loss.
Remanence: the phenomenon in which memory data decays but remains readable after power loss.
Full-disk encryption: encrypting an entire storage device, with keys normally held in memory while mounted.
Memory encryption: encrypting memory contents; it can prevent cold-boot recovery only if keys are destroyed on reset or power loss.
Side channel: leakage from a physical implementation rather than a mathematical weakness.
